vectors.name: defaults-omitted
vectors.description: No optional input: reserve 50 bps, minimum leg value 1.00 USD, no deposit, no token to exit.

vectors.name: two-tokens-default-reserve
vectors.description: An 8-decimal token at 1,250.00 USD and an 18-decimal token at 0.50 USD. The buy is capped by the reserve.

vectors.name: rounding-steps
vectors.description: Prices and balances that do not divide: every rounding step of valuation, targets, sell and buy is visible.

vectors.name: first-replication-20-usd
vectors.description: 20 USDC into three tokens of 8, 18 and 6 decimals. Buys are scaled to the budget.

vectors.name: single-constituent
vectors.description: An index with one constituent at 10,000 bps.

vectors.name: equal-64-deposit-10000-usd
vectors.description: 64 equal-weighted constituents, buy only, a deposit of 10,000 USD and no reserve.

vectors.name: blocked-first-replication-64-below-minimum
vectors.description: 20 USD into 64 constituents: every buy is below the minimum leg value, so the first replication is blocked with the deployable value that is enough.

vectors.name: blocked-first-replication-90-10
vectors.description: 9 USDC into 90/10 with every default: the buy of the 10% constituent is below 1.00 USD.

vectors.name: first-replication-at-the-stated-minimum
vectors.description: The same index with the minimum of the previous vector, rounded up to a quote base unit: both constituents are bought.

vectors.name: on-target-deposit-with-a-skipped-buy
vectors.description: A wallet on target at 90/10 and a deposit of 10 USD: one buy is below the minimum, the other is not proposed because it would leave its token above target, and the deposit stays uninvested.

vectors.name: buy-capped-at-target-weight
vectors.description: Two buys are below the minimum and the third is capped at its target weight of the projected invested value.

vectors.name: sell-scaled-to-the-buys
vectors.description: A buy is skipped and the other is capped, so the sell is reduced to the proceeds the remaining buy spends.

vectors.name: sell-raised-to-the-minimum
vectors.description: A scaled sell would be 7.00 USD under a minimum of 9.00 USD: it is raised to the minimum.

vectors.name: sell-not-needed
vectors.description: Every buy is below the minimum, so the sell that would fund them is not proposed.

vectors.name: buy-spends-what-its-quantity-costs
vectors.description: A whole-unit token at 1,250.00 USD and 1,999 USDC: one unit is bought for 1,250 USDC.

vectors.name: first-replication-drift-warning
vectors.description: Three quote base units into 60/40 buy one base unit of each token: the projected drift is compared against zero and reported.

vectors.name: exit-skipped-is-not-deployable
vectors.description: A token to exit worth less than the minimum is not sold and does not raise any target.

vectors.name: ten-million-usd
vectors.description: Four constituents worth 10,000,304.50 USD: one sell funds three scaled buys.

vectors.name: buy-only-deposit
vectors.description: A deposit into a drifted wallet in buy-only mode: nothing is sold and drift remains.

vectors.name: exit-removed-constituent
vectors.description: A token removed in the target version is sold in full. Another token outside the index is left alone.

vectors.name: minimum-leg-skips
vectors.description: A sell and a buy of 2.00 USD under a minimum of 5.00 USD: both skipped, drift unchanged.

vectors.name: minimum-leg-cascade
vectors.description: One buy is below the minimum. Capped at its target weight the other buy falls below it too, and the sell then has nothing to fund.

vectors.name: whole-unit-token
vectors.description: A token with 0 decimals at 1,000.00 USD: an excess of 500 USD is less than one unit, so nothing is sold and nothing is bought.

vectors.name: warnings-last-close-and-delayed
vectors.description: A last_close price and a delayed price are warnings and the plan is computed.

vectors.name: blocked-last-close-option
vectors.description: The same input with blockOnLastClose: the last_close price is a blocker and there is no plan.

vectors.name: blocked-missing-and-unavailable-price
vectors.description: One constituent has no price and one has an unavailable price.

vectors.name: blocked-zero-price
vectors.description: A price of zero is a blocker.

vectors.name: blocked-decimals-mismatch
vectors.description: A holding reports 8 decimals for a constituent recorded with 6.

vectors.name: blocked-zero-deployable-value
vectors.description: No constituent, no quote asset and no deposit.

vectors.name: blocked-price-without-status
vectors.description: A price with no status is not a value: the constituent is unavailable.

vectors.name: blocked-price-with-unknown-status
vectors.description: A status that is not one of the four classes is read as unavailable.

vectors.name: warning-projected-drift-increase
vectors.description: A buy-only plan cannot sell five constituents above target; the pro rata buys leave the largest constituent 367 bps under target, up from a maximum of 200 bps, and both numbers are reported.
